question: Does exact current-main Crown of the Hearth have enough natural boss-offer, selection and post-acquisition Dusk opportunity capacity to continue, or does a uniquely measured acquisition-choice bottleneck justify one identity-only acquisition-priority knob?

scientificBasis.necessaryChain: A row must first receive a Crown offer, then naturally select Crown, then win a later fight with at least one Dusk Shatter. Each step is evaluated on the same frozen policy and seed identity. The first failing necessary condition owns the decision.
scientificBasis.offerDecisionValue: A binary Crown priority can have measured decision value only when the natural offer cohort independently passes the full support, inactivity, viability and separate-anchor gates while natural selection fails the active-support minimum.
scientificBasis.claimBoundary: A post-acquisition winning Shatter proves only that Dusk Ember production was possible after ownership. The trace does not contain terminal Ember reserve, Crown proc, realised healing or missing-HP headroom, so it cannot establish activation or payoff.
scientificBasis.methodBoundary: No candidate, content edit, acquisition edit, telemetry, simulator, causal effect, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL enters this audit.

trace.selectionRule: Read the complete sole 256-row co-hand-telemetry explicit-null arm once. No row, policy or seed is selected by an endpoint.

cohort.identity: Exact identity-proved current-main policy and seed rectangle used by every necessary condition and both anchors.

definitions.bossOffer: The captured offered list at either current boss-relic boundary contains crownOfTheHearth.
definitions.naturalSelection: The frozen current-main policy chooses crownOfTheHearth from a captured boss offer.
definitions.acquisitionAct: BossRelics list index plus one. The identity-frozen capture appends a choice before start_next_act, while fight summaries use one-based act numbers.
definitions.postAcquisitionDuskOpportunity: After natural Crown selection, a later-act fight has result=win and shatters>0.
definitions.viablePolicy: A robustly active policy has at least one active row whose whole-run outcome is win.
definitions.exactInactivePolicy: No row for the policy meets the relevant predicate.
definitions.robustPolicy: At least two of the four frozen rows meet the relevant predicate.

design.type: zero-row hierarchical necessary-condition capacity audit; not a factorial, causal contrast or candidate optimisation
design.sharedAnchor: All blocks are repeated deterministic observations on the same complete trace, policies, seeds, baseline, estimator and stop rule.
design.noCartesianExpansion: No factor varies and no joint cell exists. The same cached rows are read once.

scorelinePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

afterimagePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

hearthPayoff.status: Separate fixed authored payoff; neither activation nor effect is estimated.

acquisitionPriority.conditionalNextLevel: force Crown choice only when Crown is already in the unchanged offered set
acquisitionPriority.status: Fixed in this audit. The conditional level receives identity-preflight authority only at the preregistered acquisition-choice boundary.

scoreline.definition: A robust policy plays Chisel before a later Faultline in one fight in at least two of four frozen rows.
scoreline.status: Separate overlap anchor only; no Scoreline payoff or interaction is estimated.

afterimage.definition: A robust policy simultaneously holds Ward and Warden's Edge in at least two of four frozen rows.
afterimage.status: Separate conservative overlap anchor only; no Afterimage payoff or interaction is estimated.

interactionsAndAliases.notEstimated: No causal interaction is estimated. Candidate-only, anchor-only and Jaccard counts are shared-anchor decision-value screens.
interactionsAndAliases.terminalAlias: Shatter after acquisition is an Ember-production upper bound. Automatic Lantern Art can spend Embers, missing HP can cap healing and a later win can end at zero reserve.
interactionsAndAliases.selectionAlias: Boss offer and natural selection are exact observed transitions. The binary priority target is the already-observed offer cohort; no score magnitude is tuned.
interactionsAndAliases.familyAlias: Crown post-combat reserve healing does not reopen Novaflare reserve damage, Emberdance reserve Ward, weak-mend, voluntary-loss recovery or fight-quality triggers.

estimands.primary: For boss offer, natural selection and post-acquisition Dusk opportunity separately: exact robust potential-active, exact-inactive, ambiguous and viable policy counts.
estimands.separation: Candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard counts against Scoreline and Afterimage separately for every necessary condition.
estimands.sourceBreadth: Exact natural acquisition acts and row counts for offers, selections and later Dusk opportunity.
estimands.reliability: Exact stall or error row count.
estimands.notEstimated: No terminal Ember reserve, Crown proc, realised healing, missing-HP headroom, payoff, acquisition effect, interaction, duration, RandomBuild, detector, protected-seed or product endpoint is estimated.

gates.provenance: The 16-policy support and inactivity minima, eight-policy viability and separate-anchor minima, 0.55 overlap ceiling and one-fault ceiling reuse the frozen 64-policy capacity scale without result-dependent weakening.

factorDisposition.candidate: None is constructed, simulated or promoted.
factorDisposition.payoffs: Scoreline, Afterimage and current-main Hearth payoffs remain separate and fixed.
factorDisposition.acquisitionPriority: At most one binary force-choice-when-offered knob may receive a separate exact-null and focused-mediator identity preflight after the acquisition-choice boundary. No priority value is tuned.
factorDisposition.additionalMethod: No ML, RL, optimiser, fitted model or new policy mapping is used or authorised. The acquisition-choice finding is candidate-specific and does not establish a general policy-repertoire bottleneck.
factorDisposition.protectedSeeds: Acceptance seeds 3000-5199 and reserve seeds 5200-5399 remain unused.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python verifies exact source, capture, trace, policy, seed, anchor, evidence and ledger identity; evaluates the three necessary conditions once; and owns stop/go.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The complete 64-policy by four-seed cached trace is the only look. No simulator, row, repair, subset, threshold, score increment, new condition or rerun exists.
executionAndStopping.naturalSuccessStop: Stop when offer, selection and later Dusk opportunity each pass every gate.
executionAndStopping.acquisitionChoiceStop: Stop at decision boundary 1 when the offer cohort passes every gate but natural selection fails the active-support minimum; freeze only the binary priority knob for identity preflight.
executionAndStopping.futilityStop: Stop and close the natural family when offer decision value fails or a later condition fails without the unique acquisition-choice pattern.
executionAndStopping.inconclusiveStop: Stop at the cap if any exact input or decision is unavailable or execution exceeds 30 seconds.

decisionRules.success: Either all three natural necessary conditions pass every gate, or boss offer passes every gate and natural selection uniquely fails active support.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1. For natural success, freeze only terminal-Ember observability for a separate identity preflight. For the acquisition-choice pattern, freeze only one binary force-Crown-when-already-offered priority knob for exact-null and focused-mediator identity preflight. Do not construct a candidate, change offers, vary a payoff, add a causal row, use ML/RL/optimisation or use protected seeds.
decisionRules.futility: Boss offer fails any gate, or a later necessary condition fails without the unique acquisition-choice pattern.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close the natural Ember-reserve post-combat healing family without implementation. Do not tune Crown, its score, offer rate, payoff, threshold or carrier, and do not reopen a closed family.
decisionRules.inconclusive: An exact input, trace, source, capture, anchor, ledger or decision is unavailable at the cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the capacity result inconclusive at the cap without selecting, implementing, simulating, adding telemetry or a method, or using protected seeds.
